meta.title: 12 V DC fuse and circuit protection data
standards: SAE J1888 — High current blade fuses (MAXI)

selectionRule.description: Standard automotive practice used by this tool.
steps: 1. Minimum fuse rating = 1.25 x continuous load current (headroom so the fuse does not fatigue and nuisance-blow at rated load).
2. Choose the smallest standard rating in the chosen family that is >= that minimum.
3. The chosen rating must be <= the derated ampacity of the wire it protects, otherwise the wire is the fuse. If no rating satisfies both, the wire must be upsized.
4. Fuse the conductor at the SOURCE end, as close to the battery/busbar as practical — the fuse protects the cable, not the device.
selectionRule.inrushGuidance: Blade fuses tolerate roughly 2x rated current for ~5 s and 10x for ~0.1 s. Motor and solenoid inrush of a few hundred milliseconds is normally absorbed. If inrush exceeds ~4x the fuse rating for longer than 100 ms, move to a slow-blow (MIDI) or a circuit breaker.
selectionRule.highCurrentNote: Above ~60 A continuous, blade fuses run hot and their holders are the weak point. Inverters, DC-DC chargers and winches should use bolt-down ANL, MIDI or MEGA fuses on a stud-mounted holder.

families.label: MINI / APM blade
families.notes: Standard for modern fuse boxes. Preferred for anything under 30 A.

families.label: ATO / ATC regular blade
families.notes: Legacy but universally available in NZ. Good default for a hand-built loom.

families.label: MAXI blade
families.notes: Push-in high current. Convenient but the holder contact resistance is the limiting factor above ~80 A.

families.label: MIDI / AMI bolt-down
families.notes: Bolt-down, slow-blow. The right answer for 40-150 A DC-DC chargers and accessory feeds.

families.label: MEGA / AMG bolt-down
families.notes: Main battery and alternator protection. Physically large — allow board space.

families.label: ANL bolt-down
families.notes: Highest interrupt rating of the bolt-down families. Standard for inverter feeds. Widely stocked in NZ.

families.label: Type I auto-reset circuit breaker
families.notes: Cycles on and off while faulted. Use only where an intermittent load is safer than a dead one (wipers, blowers). Never for lighting.

families.label: Type III manual-reset circuit breaker
families.notes: Manual reset button. Good for winches and service-access circuits.

holders.label: ANL inline holder, clear cover
holders.notes: Verify supplier PN — ANL holders are commodity items with no cross-manufacturer standard number.

holders.label: 6-way ATO/MINI fuse block with bus and cover
holders.notes: Total block throughput typically limited to 100 A regardless of individual fuse ratings. Verify supplier PN.

holders.label: 12-way ATO/MINI fuse block with negative bus and cover
holders.notes: Total block throughput typically limited to 100 A. Verify supplier PN.
